ordered_units.description: Define a zero-field `pub struct DisabledLiveTvManager;` (derive Debug, Default, Clone, Copy) and `#[async_trait] impl hermit_traits::stubs::LiveTvManager for DisabledLiveTvManager`. Each method returns the empty/disabled value: get_live_tv_info -> Ok(LiveTvInfo::default()); get_programs -> Ok(QueryResult::default()); reset_tuner -> Ok(()). Keep the existing crate-level doc comment. No new deps.
